title: Add-On Overpayment Reversal Amount
content:
**Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda — amount of an add-on overpayment reversal**

The add-on overpayment reversal is fixed by the following clauses.

(a) *The paid line.* This is the waiver's most recent paid GAP balance line, with its amount paid, its loss date, the date it was paid and the add-on refunds recorded on it. A waiver with no paid GAP balance line on file has no add-on overpayment reversal.

(b) *Add-on refunds received.* These are the refunds of a Kessler Shield service contract and of a Kessler Care maintenance plan financed on the waiver's purchase deal that were paid to the lienholder, each taken at the amount paid.

(c) *Uncredited add-on refund.* This is the add-on refunds received less the add-on refunds recorded on the paid line, floored at 0.00.

(d) *Overpayment.* This is the uncredited add-on refund, but never more than the benefits standing on the claim. Those are the amounts on the claim's paid and denied lines, a denied line carrying 0.00, less any benefit already reversed on the claim.

(e) *Reversal.* The add-on overpayment reversal is the overpayment rounded half up to the cent.

(f) *Recovery floor.* Nothing is reversed where either of these holds:
- the paid line paid no more than 60.00; or
- the refunds of a Kessler Shield service contract or Kessler Care maintenance plan financed on the same deal and cancelled on or after the loss date, as paid to the lienholder, exceed the add-on refunds recorded on the paid line by no more than 60.00.

### Worked figure (hypothetical)

A paid GAP balance line paid 6,420.00 and recorded 300.00 of add-on refunds. After the loss, the service contract was cancelled with 1,184.30 refunded to the lienholder, and the maintenance plan was cancelled with 266.75 refunded to the lienholder. No other line or reversal stands on the claim.

| Figure | Amount |
|---|---|
| Add-on refunds received | 1,451.05 |
| Less add-on refunds recorded on the line | 300.00 |
| Uncredited add-on refund | 1,151.05 |
| Benefits standing on the claim | 6,420.00 |
| Overpayment and reversal | 1,151.05 |

Floor test: the line paid more than 60.00, and the post-loss refunds exceed the recorded 300.00 by 1,151.05, which is more than 60.00, so the reversal stands.

### Floor boundary cases (hypothetical)

| Paid line amount | Post-loss lienholder refunds less refunds recorded on the line | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 60.00 | 700.00 | nothing reversed (the line paid no more than 60.00) |
| 60.01 | 700.00 | reversal worked out under clauses (b) to (e) |
| 4,000.00 | 60.00 | nothing reversed |
| 4,000.00 | 60.01 | reversal worked out under clauses (b) to (e) |

Where the claim's standing benefits are only 900.00 and the uncredited add-on refund is 1,151.05, the overpayment is 900.00.
